title: Reduce console live-data CLI fan-out across dashboard routes
description: apps/console/src/app/live-data.ts builds each route through many CLI calls, including work list, sync status, doctor, registry, reservation list, search, operation list, raw/wiki/report reads, and repeated work show calls. The global dashboard endpoint already returns a bounded aggregate payload, but the console still recomputes broad live data per route.
acceptanceCriteria: Live console data loading reuses bwrk dashboard global --json or an equivalent bounded aggregate where possible.
Per-route loading avoids repeated work show fan-out for routes that do not need full sprint detail.
Console server smoke records route timing or command counts so future regressions are visible.
closedReason: Live route fan-out reduced with a bounded cache and regression coverage
